must_hit.says: Primal Roar went on Necrophos at 30:25 and on Axe at 33:27. Phantom Assassin's Black King Bar opened 9 and 10 seconds later (30:34, 33:37) with Roar on cooldown. Roar stunned her through spell immunity twice (27:27, 37:56), so the one disable that works on her was spent just before she came in.
No Blink Dagger and no Black King Bar all game.

lead_also.says: Beastmaster died three times with Primal Roar ready and not cast (ability_audit: deaths with it ready and not cast), 36:05 among them at full health under four enemies.
lead_also.why: The same lesson as the roar spent before her Black King Bar — what the one disable that works on Phantom Assassin was used for — told from the deaths: the player's own ultimate, backed by ability_audit.

lead_why: Either is a lesson for a 42-minute loss in which Phantom Assassin took 7 of the 11 deaths: the ultimate spent before her Black King Bar, or no Black King Bar and no Blink all game. Two deaths in the first three minutes are not.

must_not.says: Primal Roar stunned the spell-immune Phantom Assassin twice in this game: a review must not say spell immunity stops it.
